description: Verify that SubscribeEventgroup with trailing payload (counted + uncounted) — DUT Acks both
approach:
[Objective]
Trailing payload tolerance: extra bytes after the last option must be ignored.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 endpoint option.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SubscribeAck/Nack/event per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT response matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked both trailing variants — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_ack: No first Subscribe Ack within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_second_ack: No second Subscribe Ack within listen window
